invoice_outlook_export.name: Email Manager export of Ylopo invoices + credit memos from Kevin's Outlook

invoice_pdfs.name: Ylopo invoice PDFs
invoice_pdfs.origin: Kevin's Google Drive folder of Ylopo invoice PDFs
invoice_pdfs.role: cross-check; PDF-only invoices counted only if listed in confirmed_invoices.json; others listed as unconfirmed, not counted

sources.invoice_precedence: Per invoice number: outlook_export > pdf > sheet. The month's invoices.invoice_source names the source(s) used.

assumptions.month_alignment: Invoice month = service month. Monthly Platform & Marketing invoices are billed on the 1st for that month (the $1,600 Re-Marketing line matches the Ylopo dashboard's monthly budget). Property Media and AI Services invoices are counted in the month of the invoice date. Each month's 'Previous Monthly Marketing Charge Adjustment' (a true-up for the prior month) stays in the invoice month and is NOT counted as ad spend.
assumptions.all_in_cost: Gross invoiced: sum of invoice Total by invoice month, using the Outlook export first, then PDFs, then the sheet's Invoice Summary for each invoice. Credit memos are NOT subtracted; see invoices.credits / net_of_credits.
assumptions.ad_spend: Line items in the sheet's Line Items categories 'Digital Advertising' + 'Google LSA Spend' (paid media) by invoice month. Items from the Outlook export and PDFs are mapped by item name to the same categories (e.g. 'Monthly Re-Marketing Budget' -> Digital Advertising, 'Intelligence Platform + Lead Gen' -> Software & Platform, 'Legacy Client Discount' -> Discount). Billed amounts are budgets; the next month's 'Previous Monthly Marketing Charge Adjustment' true-up is not counted as ad spend.
assumptions.credits: Credit memos (Outlook export) by credit-memo date; mostly partial credits on 3D tours/DyVA plus one $2,400 Radar AI credit. Unknown whether refunded or applied.
assumptions.cost_per_lead_denominator: Ylopo dashboard Distributed Leads (This Month), available only from 2026-10 onward; earlier months are null. 'dashboard_spend_basis_unconfirmed' divides Ylopo's displayed Total Spent (month-to-date) by Distributed Leads and is unconfirmed.
assumptions.cost_per_appointment_denominator: FUB Ylopo-sourced appointments set, by appointment created month.
assumptions.cost_per_closing_denominator: FUB Ylopo-linked closed deals, by month the deal moved to Closed.
assumptions.closings_unit: FUB Manager counts 1 unit per FUB deal in stage Closed linked to a Ylopo lead. Whether a both-sides transaction appears as 2 FUB deals (eXp transaction-ID units, both sides = 2) is not confirmed, so closings carry closings_unit='fub_deals_unconfirmed_vs_exp_units'. 5 more all-time Ylopo leads are person-stage Closed with no closed deal; they are undated and not in monthly rows.
assumptions.missing_values: null means the source does not have the number; 0 is used only when the source shows 0.

history_policy: Append-only. Rows are never edited or deleted. When a period's values change (for example the month in progress, or invoices added later), a new row for that period is appended with a later recorded_at. Use the row with the latest recorded_at for each period.
sheet_inconsistencies: Invoice INV473305 (2026-01-06): Invoice Summary 'Line Item Total' column shows $95.00 and Reconciled='No', but invoice total is $190.00 and the Line Items tab sums to $190.00.

Monthly Breakdown 2026-01 total $5,245.77 vs invoice/Line Items total $5,340.77 (diff $95.00; Monthly Breakdown Property Media $570.00 vs Line Items $665.00). The Dashboard month table shows $5,340.77.
Dashboard category 'Property Media' YTD $7,470.00 vs Line Items $7,565.00 (Dashboard category list sums to $49,277.48, not $49,372.48).

Monthly Breakdown splits out an 'LSA Tech Charge' column ($350/mo); in Line Items and Charge Breakdown those Google LSA platform fees are under 'Software & Platform'. This file uses the Line Items categories.
The sheet only has invoices dated 2026-01 through 2026-08; later months come from the Outlook export/PDFs if present, otherwise their costs are null.

cost_per_matched_months.note: Cost and FUB counts summed over the same months only (months with at least one counted invoice from any source), so the numerator and denominator cover one period.

lead.note: Uses only months that have both invoices and a Ylopo dashboard Distributed Leads reading (cost of those months / their distributed leads); null until one exists.

totals.credits_note: Credit memos are listed by credit-memo date and shown separately; all_in_cost is gross invoiced. Whether each credit was refunded or applied to a later invoice is unknown.

agents_note: Empty: no source gives per-agent Ylopo numbers yet. Names only when populated; no contact details.

invoices_unconfirmed_pdf_only.label: unconfirmed: invoice found only in Drive PDFs (not in Outlook export or sheet); NOT counted in invoices/cost_per

marketing_snapshot.avg_cost_per_distributed_lead_note: Recorded as Ylopo displays it ($0). Looks inconsistent with $1,464.47 spent and 32 distributed leads; unconfirmed.

ppc_performance.note: Dashboard states no PPC spend in the trailing 12 months and no campaign data for the current month.
